clickwrap.stepLead: As a handledare you sit alongside a learner during supervised practice driving. Read the terms below, then tick the box to confirm you meet the requirements.

bodyParagraphs.0: DriveLinkUp is a directory. If you sign up as handledare we connect learners and handledare for supervised-practice guidance. We do not arrange insurance, supervise the sessions, or carry liability for what happens at the wheel. By ticking the box you confirm that your motor insurance covers supervised practice driving (övningskörning) with a learner, and that you can show evidence of it (your insurer’s confirmation or the policy schedule).
bodyParagraphs.1: Liability for supervised sessions rests with you and the learner during those sessions. DriveLinkUp is not a party to the arrangement between handledare and learner. If an incident occurs, the involved parties’ insurance — not DriveLinkUp — is the right first conversation.
bodyParagraphs.2: These terms may be updated. When we change them materially we will ask you to accept again. A record of every acceptance — version and date — is stored against your account.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.intro: This notice explains how DriveLinkUp processes personal data when you browse the directory, create an account, contact a school, or write to us. It describes current processing only. DriveLinkUp does not book lessons or take lesson payments.

0.title: 1. Controller and contact
0.body: DriveLinkUp is the controller for the personal data described here. We have not published a registered company name or organisation number on this page. Write to support@drivelinkup.com with “Privacy” in the subject. If we register a Swedish company we will add the legal name and organisation number here.

1.title: 2. Personal data we collect
1.body: What we collect depends on how you use the site. We do not currently collect card numbers, and learner signup does not scan identity documents.
items: Account details: name, email address, hashed password, and role (learner, school, or handledare).
The date of birth you enter at learner signup. We use it only to check that you are 16 or older. It is not treated as a verified date of birth for booking.
Optional profile photo that you choose to upload.
School onboarding details such as school name, organisation number, and city.
A teaching-licence file if you upload one. We store it to review the listing. That is not an automatic check with Transportstyrelsen.
Handledare insurance attestation (your confirmation and the time you gave it), not the insurance document unless you send that to support.
Support messages you send on the contact form. Those are emailed to support@drivelinkup.com. We do not keep a separate public contact database.
Questions you type into the on-site assistant. The text is sent to OpenAI to generate a reply.
Approximate coordinates when you click “Use my location”, sent with the directory request so we can sort schools. We do not save that location on your account.
Cookie choice, policy version, and a hash of IP address plus browser information. We do not store the raw IP on the consent record.
Technical logs such as IP address, browser information, and security events needed to run and protect the site.
Name, email, and profile photo that Google shares if you sign in with Google.
Published prices, categories, and listing text taken from a school's own website so the directory can show what the school already publishes.
Google reviews we store and show on a listing, marked as coming from Google. We do not verify those reviews.
Details about another person if you include them in a support message or an assistant question.

2.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
2.body: We process personal data only for the purposes below. Each purpose has a GDPR Article 6 basis.
items: Provide the directory, your account, and a school listing — Article 6(1)(b) contract.
Check that a learner account is 16 or older from the date you enter — Article 6(1)(b) contract and Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in keeping the service off-limits to children.
Send product email such as address verification, password reset, and school invites — Article 6(1)(b) contract.
Answer support and contact-form messages — Article 6(1)(b) contract or Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in helping you.
Reply to assistant questions you choose to type — Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in answering routine questions.
Review an optional teaching-licence file — Article 6(1)(b) contract and Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in reviewing a listing.
Record cookie choices and keep the site secure — Article 6(1)(c) legal obligation and Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in security and proof of consent.
Load Google AdSense after you accept marketing cookies — Article 6(1)(a) consent.
We do not currently take lesson payments. If checkout is turned on later, this notice will be updated before that processing starts.

3.title: 4. Cookies and similar technologies
3.body: Essential cookies run the site. Optional cookies wait for your choice in the banner. Changing the banner or clearing cookies lets you choose again. A new policy version also asks again.
items: Essential: session, security, language, and the cookie that remembers this choice. These stay on.
Analytics: we do not currently load a separate analytics tool. The toggle is reserved. Leaving it off keeps it off.

Marketing: Google AdSense loads only after you accept marketing cookies. Google may set its own cookies and collect device and usage data to show ads. See Google’s advertising policy at https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads.
If you withdraw marketing consent we stop loading new AdSense scripts. Cookies Google already set may remain until you clear them in the browser.

4.title: 5. Recipients
4.body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with the vendors that run the site, the school you contact yourself, or when the law requires it.
items: Vercel hosts the website and may store profile photos.
Neon hosts the PostgreSQL database.
Cloudflare R2 may store uploaded photos or teaching-licence files.
Resend sends product email.
Google provides optional sign-in and, after marketing consent, AdSense.
OpenAI processes assistant messages you type.
A school you email or visit becomes a separate controller for the details you send them.
Authorities or advisors may receive data when Swedish or EU law requires it, or to establish, exercise, or defend a legal claim.

5.title: 6. International transfers
5.body: Some vendors process data outside the EU/EEA, including in the United States (Vercel, Google, OpenAI, and Resend). Where required we rely on an adequacy decision or the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses. Ask support@drivelinkup.com if you want more detail on a transfer.

6.title: 7. How long we keep data
6.body: We keep data only as long as the purpose needs, then delete or anonymise it, unless Swedish law requires a longer period.
items: Account and profile data stay while the account is open. You can delete the account from Profile.
After deletion we may keep hashed consent events and append-only verification logs as an audit trail. A handledare enrollment is revoked, not erased.
Teaching-licence files stay until the review ends or the account is deleted.
Support email stays as long as the request needs.
Technical logs stay for a limited security period.
Assistant messages are processed to answer you. We do not keep a public chat history on your profile.

7.title: 8. Your rights
7.body: Under the GDPR you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and data portability where the legal conditions are met. Where we rely on consent you may withdraw it at any time. Withdrawal does not affect processing that already happened.
items: Delete your account from Profile. That is the self-service erasure path.
Write to support@drivelinkup.com for access, correction, or another rights request.
Object to processing based on legitimate interest, including the assistant, and we will stop unless we have a compelling ground to continue.
Lodge a complaint with Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (IMY), https://www.imy.se.

8.title: 9. Age
8.body: DriveLinkUp is for people aged 16 and over. It is not a service for children. We do not knowingly create accounts for anyone under 16. If you believe a child has an account, write to support@drivelinkup.com and we will close it.

9.title: 10. Automated decisions
9.body: We do not make solely automated decisions that produce legal effects or similarly significant effects. The 16+ check is a simple age rule from the date you enter.

10.title: 11. Schools you contact
10.body: Contact the school is between you and the school. If you send them your name, email, or phone number, that school decides how to handle those details. DriveLinkUp is not their processor for that conversation.

11.title: 12. Changes
11.body: We update this notice when the service or the processing changes. The date and version above are the current ones. A material change bumps the version and the cookie banner asks again. Questions: support@drivelinkup.com.

12.title: 13. How we collect data
12.body: Like other directories, we collect data in three ways. We only use each source for the purposes in this notice.
items: You give it to us: account details, the date of birth you enter, photos, school onboarding, a teaching-licence file, handledare attestation, support messages, and assistant questions.
It is collected automatically when you use the site: technical logs, cookie choice, and approximate coordinates if you click Use my location.

We receive it from others: Google if you sign in with Google; a school's public website for prices and listing facts; Google for reviews we display; and a school you write to, if they reply to us about that message.

13.title: 14. What is public on a listing
13.body: A school listing is public. Anyone can see the school's name, city, published prices, categories, bio, photo, and Google reviews we display. Your learner account, date of birth, password, teaching-licence file, and support messages are not shown on the public listing.
items: If you run a school listing, do not put another person's private details in the public bio.
We may hide or remove a listing that is inaccurate, unlawful, or that we must take down to protect users or comply with law.

14.title: 15. Security
14.body: No site can promise perfect security. We use administrative and technical measures that fit a service of this size: hashed passwords, access limited to people who operate the site, HTTPS, and storage of uploads with our hosting vendors. If we become aware of a personal-data breach that must be notified under the GDPR, we will notify IMY and affected people when the law requires it.

15.title: 16. Other sites and apps
15.body: Listings may link to a school's website, maps, or social profiles. Those sites have their own controllers and policies. DriveLinkUp is not responsible for how they handle personal data. The same applies if you leave a review on Google or open an ad that Google shows after marketing consent.
